entries.027c3e98c4026dfd: In response to customer demand, this business mainly performs packing of export cargo. 3 subsidiaries in Thailand, Taiwan and Indonesia are involved.
entries.0671f42c3c88c611: In response to shippers' demand, this business arranges cargo transport using the services of ship operators, air carriers and road freight carriers. Consolidated subsidiaries and Goyo Kaiun Co., Ltd. are involved.
entries.15e78c8cf7ff6506: This business transports, intermediately processes and recycles general and industrial waste. The company's Sorami Recycling Center and others are responsible for this business.
entries.205be5ea215556da: A comprehensive logistics group based at the Port of Nagoya that handles port transportation, warehousing, customs clearance and more across sea, land and air.
entries.3a2875f49d2a0e2f: In response to shippers' demand, this business transports cargo by truck. 4 companies, including Kokusai Butsuryu Co., Ltd. and subsidiaries in Thailand, the United States and Indonesia, are involved, and the company itself is not responsible for this business.
entries.590ddb2dd5c8c8e6: This business stores goods entrusted by shippers in warehouses and carries out related cargo handling work. 8 companies, including Meikyo Soko Co., Ltd. and local corporations in Thailand, the United States, Germany, China, Hong Kong, Indonesia and Mexico, are involved.
entries.64c1a72210b0257e: The group, made up of the company, 12 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate (14 companies in total), operates a single segment. The company is responsible for all businesses other than the General Truck Transportation Business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥57,893 million.
entries.85566403bc9ccf32: This business is related to the businesses listed above. Consolidated subsidiaries and Goyo Kaiun Co., Ltd. are involved.
entries.d4bb771dd7f99626: This business acts as agent for airlines, handling international air cargo and issuing air waybills and related operations. 2 companies, ISEWAN U.S.A. INC. and Taiwan Isewan Gufen Youxian Gongsi, are involved.
entries.da5cd9e7c932b341: This business acts as agent or proxy for consignors in customs clearance procedures with customs authorities for imported and exported cargo. 6 companies, including Kokusai Butsuryu Co., Ltd. and subsidiaries in Thailand, the United States, China, Taiwan and Indonesia, together with Goyo Kaiun Co., Ltd., are involved.
entries.de279061d12c7553: Transport and Recycling Treatment of General and Industrial Waste Business
entries.f5455a1a33b24a6e: The business consists of general port transportation, port cargo handling and lighter transportation under the Port Transportation Business Act. Centered on receiving and delivering cargo at ports, it also conducts container terminal management and operation, shed storage, lighter transportation and other activities. Kokusai Butsuryu Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, and Goyo Kaiun Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate, are also involved.
